about: the web: a page is a source, once; its regions beneath it keep its hierarchy; its links and the names it uses are references the overlay follows

land.region: /web/pages/{host}/{slug}/<heading>...  (nested by heading level: the page's own hierarchy)

note: a region's text is prose with references in it, each a path in brackets: a hyperlink the author wrote, landed by this scheme, or a name a reader placed. No other record, no other slot.
